title: Authentication and Session Demo
objective: Build a secure authentication flow for a small application.

milestones.title: Model and scope
acceptance_criteria: Use synthetic data and document at least one negative/failure test.

milestones.title: Implement the control
acceptance_criteria: Use synthetic data and document at least one negative/failure test.

milestones.title: Verify and document
acceptance_criteria: Use synthetic data and document at least one negative/failure test.

stretch_features: Add risk-based test prioritization and traceability to a relevant ASVS requirement.
Add a clear operational recovery/rollback note and a privacy-aware evidence-retention policy.
tests: Tests for valid and invalid input/roles/states as applicable.
Negative tests for denied permissions and failure paths.
Regression tests for every confirmed finding fixed.
Manual review of deployment/configuration assumptions where automation cannot prove behavior.
review_method: Human review plus local unit/integration tests and controlled manual verification. CodeLeaf does not execute submitted server-side code in the FastAPI process; use only a separate isolated runner if execution automation is later added.
status_note: Use a local-only test database, synthetic accounts, and a framework-provided session/authentication pattern. All test targets must be owned, local, intentionally vulnerable training fixtures, or explicitly authorized. Provider integrations use test mode and synthetic data.
